prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1150; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Houston. Can you start by telling me where you were when it happened?

A: Sure. I was pulling into a space near the back entrance of the shopping center, going pretty slowly, maybe five miles an hour.

Q: Okay. Which direction were you traveling, and what was the other vehicle doing?

A: I was heading toward the open space on the left. The other car came backing out of the space right next to it, and he didn't seem to look behind him before he started moving.

Q: Did you have a chance to stop or steer away?

A: I hit the brakes as soon as I saw the back-up lights, but there wasn't enough room. His rear bumper clipped the front corner of my driver's side.

Q: Did you exit your vehicle after the impact?

A: Yes, I got out to look at the damage. My knee kind of gave out when I stepped down from the seat. I had to lean on the door for a minute.

Q: Did you receive medical attention?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon. They looked at my right knee, took some X-rays, and said it was swollen and sore. They wrapped it and told me to rest it and follow up with my doctor.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. Walking up stairs is painful, and I've been using a brace most days. I have a follow-up appointment scheduled next week.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was driving carefully and I'm hoping this gets sorted out quickly, since I'm having trouble getting around.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
